bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties
bookInfo.author: Xue Juzheng et al.

title.zh: 卷七十二 唐書48: 列傳24 張承業 張居翰 馬紹宏 孟漢瓊
title.en: Volume 72 Book of Later Tang 48: Biographies 24 - Zhang Chengye, Zhang Juhan, Ma Shaohong, Meng Hangqiong
title.raw: 卷七十二 唐書48: 列傳24 張承業 張居翰 馬紹宏 孟漢瓊 Volume 72 Book of Later Tang 48: Biographies 24 - Zhang Chengye, Zhang Juhan, Ma Shaohong, Meng Hangqiong

sentences.zh: 張承業，字繼元，本姓康，同州人。

translations.literal: Zhang Chengye, styled Jiyuan, was originally surnamed Kang and was a native of Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chengye, styled Jiyuan, was originally of the Kang clan and came from Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，內常侍張泰畜為假子。

translations.literal: During the Xiantong reign, Palace Attendant Zhang Tai raised him as an adopted son.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiantong era, the palace attendant Zhang Tai took him in as an adopted son.

sentences.zh: 光啟中，主郃陽軍事，賜紫，入為內供奉。

translations.literal: During the Guangqi reign, he was placed in charge of military affairs at Heyang, granted purple robes, and entered service as an inner palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the Guangqi era he took charge of military affairs at Heyang, received the purple robe, and entered the palace as an inner attendant.

sentences.zh: 武皇之討王行瑜，承業累奉使渭北，因留監武皇軍事，賊平，改酒坊使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu campaigned against Wang Xingyu, Chengye repeatedly served as envoy north of the Wei River and was then left behind to supervise Emperor Wu's military affairs. After the rebels were pacified, he was reassigned as Commissioner of the Wine Monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wu marched against Wang Xingyu, Chengye was sent repeatedly as envoy to the country north of the Wei River and then stayed on to supervise the army. After the rebels were crushed, he was made Commissioner of the Wine Monopoly.

sentences.zh: 三年，昭宗將幸太原，以承業與武皇善，用除為河東監軍，密令迎駕。

translations.literal: In the third year, when Emperor Zhaozong was about to travel to Taiyuan, because Chengye was on good terms with Emperor Wu, he was appointed army supervisor of Hedong and secretly ordered to welcome the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, as Emperor Zhaozong prepared to visit Taiyuan, Chengye—who was on good terms with Emperor Wu—was appointed Hedong army supervisor and secretly ordered to welcome the emperor.

sentences.zh: 既而昭宗幸華州，就加左監門衛將軍。

translations.literal: Before long Emperor Zhaozong went to Hua Prefecture, and Chengye was promoted on the spot to General of the Left Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Emperor Zhaozong went to Hua Prefecture, and Chengye was promoted on the spot to General of the Left Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 駕在鳳翔，承業屢請出師晉、絳，以為岐人掎角。

translations.literal: While the imperial carriage was at Fengxiang, Chengye repeatedly asked to march troops from Jin and Jiang so as to threaten the Qi forces from a flanking position.
translations.idiomatic: While the court was at Fengxiang, Chengye repeatedly urged sending troops from Jin and Jiang to pin down Li Maozhen's Qi forces from the flank.

sentences.zh: 崔魏公之誅宦官也，武皇偽戮罪人首級以奉詔，匿承業於斛律寺，昭宗遇弑，乃復請為監軍。

translations.literal: When Duke Cui executed the eunuchs, Emperor Wu feigned slaying the heads of condemned criminals to comply with the edict and hid Chengye at Huli Temple. After Emperor Zhaozong was assassinated, Chengye again requested to serve as army supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: When Duke Cui moved against the eunuchs, Emperor Wu pretended to execute condemned criminals' heads to satisfy the edict and hid Chengye at Huli Temple. After Emperor Zhaozong was murdered, Chengye again asked to serve as army supervisor.

sentences.zh: 夾城之役，遣承業求援於鳳翔。

translations.literal: During the campaign at Jiachcheng, Chengye was sent to Fengxiang to seek reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege of Jiachcheng, Chengye was dispatched to Fengxiang to seek aid.

sentences.zh: 時河中阻絕，自離石渡河，春冰方泮，淩澌奔蹙，艤舟不得渡，因禱河神。

translations.literal: The route through Hezhong was blocked. Crossing the river from Lishi, the spring ice had just begun to melt; floes surged and piled up, and the boat could not reach shore to cross, so he prayed to the River God.
translations.idiomatic: The route through Hezhong was cut off. He crossed from Lishi, but the spring ice was just breaking up; floes surged and piled together, and his boat could not reach the bank. He prayed to the River God.

sentences.zh: 是夜，夢神人謂曰：「子但渡，流冰無患。」

translations.literal: That night he dreamed a divine being say to him, "You have only to cross — the drifting ice will do you no harm."
translations.idiomatic: That night he dreamed a divine being say to him, "Just cross — the drifting ice will not harm you."

sentences.zh: 既寤，津吏報曰：「河冰合矣。」

translations.literal: When he awoke, the ferry officer reported, "The river ice has frozen solid."
translations.idiomatic: When he awoke, the ferry officer reported, "The river has frozen over."

sentences.zh: 淩晨，躡冰而濟，旋踵冰解。

translations.literal: At daybreak he crossed on the ice; the instant he reached the other bank, the ice broke apart.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak he crossed on the ice, and the moment he reached the far bank the ice broke up.

sentences.zh: 使還，武皇病篤，啟手之夕，召承業屬之曰：「吾兒孤弱，群臣縱橫，後事公善籌之。」

translations.literal: On his return from the mission, Emperor Wu was gravely ill. On the night he passed away, he summoned Chengye and entrusted him, saying, "My son is young and weak, and the ministers are unruly; you must take good thought for what follows."
translations.idiomatic: When he returned from the mission, Emperor Wu was dying. On the night of his death he summoned Chengye and said, "My son is young and weak, and the ministers are unruly. You must plan carefully for what comes next."

sentences.zh: 承業奉遺顧，爰立嗣王，平內難，策略居多。

translations.literal: Chengye fulfilled the dying charge, established the heir as king, and pacified internal turmoil — in these matters strategic planning was largely his.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye carried out the dying charge, established the heir as king, and quelled the internal crisis — in all of this, strategy was largely his work.

sentences.zh: 既終易月之制，即請出師救潞，破賊夾城。

translations.literal: Once the one-month mourning period was complete, he immediately asked to lead troops to rescue Lu and broke the enemy at Jiachcheng.
translations.idiomatic: When the one-month mourning period ended, he immediately asked to march out and relieve Lu, defeating the enemy at Jiachcheng.

sentences.zh: 莊宗深感其意，兄事之，親幸承業私第，升堂拜母，賜遺優厚。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong was deeply moved by this devotion and treated Chengye as an elder brother. He personally visited Chengye's private residence, entered the hall to pay respects to his mother, and lavished generous gifts upon him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong was deeply moved and treated Chengye as an elder brother. He visited Chengye's home in person, entered the hall to bow to his mother, and gave him lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 時莊宗初行墨製，凡除拜之命，皆成於盧汝弼之手。

translations.literal: At that time Zhuangzong had just begun issuing orders in his own hand; every appointment and commission was drafted by Lu Rubi.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Zhuangzong had just begun issuing appointments in his own hand, and every commission was drafted by Lu Rubi.

sentences.zh: 汝弼既自為戶部侍郎，乃請與承業改官及開國邑，承業拒而不受。

translations.literal: After Rubi had made himself Vice Minister of Revenue, he asked to have Chengye's office and noble domain changed; Chengye refused and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: After Rubi had made himself Vice Minister of Revenue, he asked to have Chengye's title and noble domain changed. Chengye refused.

sentences.zh: 其後，但稱本朝舊官而已。

translations.literal: Thereafter he referred only to his original Tang title.
translations.idiomatic: After that he used only his original Tang title.

sentences.zh: 天祐中，幽州劉守光敗，其府掾馮道歸太原，承業辟為本院巡官。

translations.literal: During the Tianyou reign, when Liu Shouguang of You Prefecture was defeated, his staff officer Feng Dao returned to Taiyuan, and Chengye recruited him as inspector of his own office.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianyou era, after Liu Shouguang of Youzhou was defeated, his staff officer Feng Dao returned to Taiyuan and Chengye recruited him as inspector of his office.

sentences.zh: 承業重其文章履行，甚見待遇。

translations.literal: Chengye valued Feng's literary talent and conduct and treated him with considerable favor.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye valued Feng's literary talent and character and treated him with great favor.

sentences.zh: 時有周元豹者，善人倫鑒，與道不合，謂承業曰：「馮生無前程，公不可過用。」

translations.literal: At the time there was a man named Zhou Yuanbao, skilled at judging character, who did not get along with Feng and told Chengye, "Feng has no future ahead of him — you must not overemploy him."
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was a Zhou Yuanbao, skilled at reading men, who disliked Feng and told Chengye, "Feng has no future — you must not promote him too far."

sentences.zh: 管書記盧質聞之曰：「我曾見杜黃裳司空寫真圖，道之狀貌酷類焉，將來必副大用，元豹之言，不足信也。」

translations.literal: Chief secretary Lu Zhi heard this and said, "I once saw the portrait of Minister Du Huangshang; Feng's appearance closely resembles it. He will surely prove fit for high employment — Yuanbao's words are not to be trusted."
translations.idiomatic: Chief secretary Lu Zhi heard this and said, "I once saw the portrait of Minister Du Huangshang. Feng looks remarkably like him and will surely prove fit for high office — Yuanbao's words are not to be trusted."

sentences.zh: 承業薦為霸府從事焉。

translations.literal: Chengye recommended him and made him a staff officer of the hegemon's office.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye recommended him and made him a staff officer at the hegemon's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 柏鄉之役，王師既逼汴營，周德威慮其奔衝，堅請退舍。

translations.literal: At the battle of Baixiang, the royal army had already pressed close to the Bian camp. Zhou Dewei, fearing a sudden charge, strongly urged falling back.
translations.idiomatic: At Baixiang the royal army had already pressed the Bian camp. Zhou Dewei, fearing a sudden charge, strongly urged a withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 莊宗怒其懦，不聽，垂帳而寢，諸將不敢言事，鹹詣監軍請白。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong, angered at what he saw as cowardice, would not listen. He lowered his curtain and went to sleep; the generals dared not speak up and all went to the army supervisor to ask him to intercede.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong, angry at what he took for cowardice, refused to listen. He lowered his curtain and went to sleep. The generals dared not speak and all went to the army supervisor to ask him to intervene.

sentences.zh: 承業遽至牙門，褰帳而入，撫莊宗曰：「此非王安寢時，周德威老將，洞識兵勢，姑務萬全，言不可忽。」

translations.literal: Chengye hastened to the headquarters gate, lifted the curtain, and entered. Placing a hand on Zhuangzong he said, "This is no time for Your Highness to sleep. Zhou Dewei is a veteran general who thoroughly understands battlefield conditions; for the moment seek absolute safety — his words must not be ignored."
translations.idiomatic: Chengye hurried to headquarters, lifted the curtain, and went in. Placing a hand on Zhuangzong he said, "This is no time to sleep. Zhou Dewei is a veteran who knows the battlefield inside out. For now seek complete safety — do not ignore what he says."

sentences.zh: 莊宗蹶然而興曰：「予方思之。」

translations.literal: Zhuangzong started up suddenly and said, "I was just thinking about it."
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong started up at once and said, "I was just thinking about that."

sentences.zh: 其夕，收軍保鄗邑。

translations.literal: That evening he drew the army back and held Haoyi.
translations.idiomatic: That evening he pulled the army back and held Haoyi.

sentences.zh: 德威討劉守光，令承業往視賊勢，因請莊宗自行，果成大捷。

translations.literal: When Dewei marched against Liu Shouguang, he sent Chengye to observe the enemy's strength and urged Zhuangzong to take the field himself; the result was a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Dewei marched against Liu Shouguang, he sent Chengye to scout the enemy and urged Zhuangzong to take command in person. The result was a great victory.

sentences.zh: 承業感武皇厚遇，自莊宗在魏州垂十年，太原軍國政事，一委承業；

translations.literal: Grateful for Emperor Wu's generous treatment of him, and with Zhuangzong at Weizhou for nearly ten years, all military and civil affairs of Taiyuan were entrusted solely to Chengye;
translations.idiomatic: Grateful for Emperor Wu's generous treatment, and with Zhuangzong at Weizhou for nearly ten years, all military and civil affairs at Taiyuan were entrusted entirely to Chengye;

sentences.zh: 而積聚庾帑，收兵市馬，招懷流散，勸課農桑，成是霸基者，承業之忠力也。

translations.literal: It was through Chengye's loyal exertions that grain was stockpiled, troops gathered and horses purchased, displaced people brought back, and agriculture encouraged — all of which built the foundation of hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: It was Chengye's loyal exertions that stockpiled grain, gathered troops and bought horses, brought back the displaced, and encouraged farming — all of which built the foundation of hegemony.

sentences.zh: 時貞簡太后，韓德妃、伊淑妃、諸宅王之貴，洎王之介弟在晉陽宮，或不以其道幹於承業，悉不聽，逾法禁者必懲，由是貴戚斂手，民俗丕變。

translations.literal: At that time the Empress Dowager Zhenjian, the honored consorts Han Defei and Yi Shufei, the various princes of the household, and the king's younger brothers who lived in the Jinyang palace — some tried to influence Chengye by improper means, but he refused them all; anyone who exceeded the legal prohibitions was punished. Thereupon the imperial kin held back their hands, and popular customs changed greatly.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Empress Dowager Zhenjian, the consorts Han Defei and Yi Shufei, the household princes, and the king's younger brothers at the Jinyang palace — some tried to influence Chengye by improper means, but he refused them all and punished anyone who broke the law. The imperial kin held back, and popular customs changed greatly.

sentences.zh: 或有中傷承業於莊宗者，言專弄威柄，廣納賂遺。

translations.literal: Some slandered Chengye to Zhuangzong, saying he monopolized power and widely accepted bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Some slandered Chengye to Zhuangzong, saying he wielded power alone and accepted bribes on a wide scale.

sentences.zh: 莊宗歲時還晉陽宮省太后，須錢蒱博、給伶官，嘗置酒於泉府，莊宗酣飲，命興聖宮使李繼岌為承業起舞，既竟，承業出寶帶幣馬奉之。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong returned to the Jinyang palace each year to visit the empress dowager, he needed money for gambling and to pay the entertainers. Once he held a feast at the treasury office. Zhuangzong drank deeply and ordered Li Jiya, commissioner of the Xingsheng Palace, to dance for Chengye; when it was done, Chengye produced a precious belt, coins, and a horse as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Each year when Zhuangzong returned to the Jinyang palace to visit the empress dowager, he needed money for gambling and to pay the entertainers. Once he held a feast at the treasury. Zhuangzong drank heavily and ordered Li Jiya, commissioner of the Xingsheng Palace, to dance for Chengye. When the dance was done, Chengye presented a precious belt, coins, and a horse as gifts.

sentences.zh: 莊宗指錢積謂承業曰：「和哥無錢使，七哥與此一積，寶馬非殊惠也。」

translations.literal: Zhuangzong pointed to a pile of money and said to Chengye, "Hege has no money to spend — Seventh Elder Brother, give him this pile. The fine horse is no extraordinary favor."
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong pointed to a pile of money and said to Chengye, "Hege has no spending money — Seventh Elder Brother, give him this pile. The fine horse is no special favor."

sentences.zh: 承業謝曰：「郎君哥勞，承業自出己俸錢。

translations.literal: Chengye declined, saying, "The young lord's labors — Chengye will pay from his own salary.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye declined, saying, "For the young lord's service, Chengye will pay from his own salary.

sentences.zh: 此錢是大王庫物，準擬支贍三軍，不敢以公物為私禮也。」

translations.literal: This money belongs to the Great King's treasury, earmarked to supply the three armies. I dare not use public goods as a private gift."
translations.idiomatic: This money belongs to the Great King's treasury and is earmarked to supply the three armies. I dare not use public funds as a private gift."

sentences.zh: 莊宗不悅，使酒侵承業。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong was displeased and, in his cups, insulted Chengye.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong was displeased and, drunk, insulted Chengye.

sentences.zh: 承業曰：「臣老敕使。

translations.literal: Chengye said, "Your servant is an old imperial envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye said, "Your servant is an old imperial envoy.

sentences.zh: 非為子孫之謀，惜錢為大王基業，王若自要散施，何妨老夫，不過財盡兵散，一事無成。」

translations.literal: It is not for my descendants' sake that I spare this money — I spare it for the Great King's foundation. If Your Highness insists on giving it away, what harm can an old man do? Nothing more than that wealth will be exhausted, troops dispersed, and nothing achieved."
translations.idiomatic: I am not hoarding it for my descendants — I am hoarding it for the Great King's foundation. If Your Highness insists on giving it away, what can an old man do? Nothing more than exhaust the treasury, scatter the troops, and achieve nothing."

sentences.zh: 〈（案：《通鑒》作王自取用之，何問仆為！）〉

translations.literal: (Note: The Zizhi Tongjian reads: "The king may take and use it himself — why ask your servant!")〉
translations.idiomatic: (Note: The Zizhi Tongjian has: "The king may take and use it himself — why ask your servant!")〉

sentences.zh: 莊宗怒，顧元行欽曰：「取劍來！」

translations.literal: Zhuangzong flew into a rage and turned to Yuan Xingqin, saying, "Bring a sword!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong flew into a rage and turned to Yuan Xingqin, saying, "Bring a sword!"

sentences.zh: 承業引莊宗衣，泣而言曰：「仆荷先王遺顧，誓為本朝誅汴賊，為王惜庫物，斬承業首，死亦無愧於先王，今日請死！」

translations.literal: Chengye seized Zhuangzong's robe and said through tears, "Your servant received the late king's dying charge and swore to exterminate the Bian rebels for the dynasty and to husband the treasury stores for the king. If you cut off Chengye's head, I will die without shame before the late king — I ask to die today!"
translations.idiomatic: Chengye seized Zhuangzong's robe and said through tears, "Your servant received the late king's dying charge and swore to destroy the Bian rebels for the dynasty and to guard the treasury for the king. Cut off Chengye's head and I will die without shame before the late king — I ask to die today!"

sentences.zh: 閻寶解承業手，令退。

translations.literal: Yan Bao loosened Chengye's grip and had him withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Bao loosened Chengye's grip and made him withdraw.

sentences.zh: 承業詬寶曰：「黨朱溫逆賊，未嘗有一言效忠，而敢依阿諂附。」

translations.literal: Chengye reviled Bao, saying, "You sided with the rebel Zhu Wen and never once spoke a word of loyalty — yet you dare fawn and flatter."
translations.idiomatic: Chengye reviled Bao, saying, "You sided with the rebel Zhu Wen and never once spoke a word of loyalty — yet you dare fawn and flatter."

sentences.zh: 揮拳踣之。

translations.literal: He swung his fist and knocked him down.
translations.idiomatic: He swung his fist and knocked him down.

sentences.zh: 太后聞莊宗酒失，急召入。

translations.literal: The empress dowager, hearing of Zhuangzong's drunken offense, urgently summoned him in.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager, hearing of Zhuangzong's drunken outburst, urgently summoned him.

sentences.zh: 莊宗性至孝，聞太后召，叩頭謝阿業曰：「吾杯酒之間，忤於七哥，太后必怪吾。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong was exceedingly filial; hearing the empress dowager's summons, he kowtowed and apologized to Aye: "Between a few cups of wine I offended Seventh Elder Brother — the empress dowager is sure to blame me.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong was deeply filial. Hearing the empress dowager's summons, he kowtowed and apologized to Aye: "Over a few cups of wine I offended Seventh Elder Brother — the empress dowager is sure to blame me.

sentences.zh: 七哥為痛飲兩卮分謗，可乎？」

translations.literal: Seventh Elder Brother, will you drink two cups in earnest to share the blame?"
translations.idiomatic: Seventh Elder Brother, will you drink two cups in earnest to share the blame?"

sentences.zh: 莊宗連飲四鍾，勸承業，竟不飲。

translations.literal: Zhuangzong drank four cups in succession and urged Chengye to drink, but he would not.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong drank four cups in a row and urged Chengye to drink, but Chengye would not.

sentences.zh: 莊宗歸宮，太后使人謂承業曰：「小兒忤特進，已笞矣，可歸第。」

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong returned to the palace, the empress dowager sent someone to tell Chengye, "The boy offended the Special Advancement — he has already been flogged. You may return home."
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong returned to the palace, the empress dowager sent word to Chengye: "The boy offended the Special Advancement and has already been flogged. You may go home."

sentences.zh: 翌日，太后與莊宗俱幸其第，慰勞之。

translations.literal: The next day the empress dowager and Zhuangzong both visited his residence to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the empress dowager and Zhuangzong both visited his home to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 自是私謁幾絕。

translations.literal: From then on private audiences nearly ceased.
translations.idiomatic: From then on private visits nearly ceased.

sentences.zh: 十四年，承製授開府儀同三司、左衛上將軍、燕國公，固辭不受。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was granted by imperial rescript the titles of Grand Preceptor with ceremonials equal to the Three Dukes, General-in-Chief of the Left Guard, and Duke of Yan — he firmly declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was granted by rescript the titles of Grand Preceptor with ceremonials equal to the Three Dukes, General-in-Chief of the Left Guard, and Duke of Yan. He firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 是時，盧質在莊宗幕下，嗜酒輕傲，嘗呼莊宗諸弟為豚犬，莊宗深銜之。

translations.literal: At that time Lu Zhi was on Zhuangzong's staff. He was fond of drink and lightly arrogant; he once called Zhuangzong's younger brothers "pigs and dogs," and Zhuangzong deeply resented it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Lu Zhi was on Zhuangzong's staff. He was fond of drink and lightly arrogant and once called Zhuangzong's younger brothers "pigs and dogs." Zhuangzong deeply resented it.

sentences.zh: 承業慮質被禍，因乘間謂莊宗曰：「盧質多行無禮，臣請為大王殺之，可乎？」

translations.literal: Chengye feared that Zhi would come to harm, and seizing an opportunity said to Zhuangzong, "Lu Zhi repeatedly behaves without propriety — your servant asks to kill him for the Great King. May I?"
translations.idiomatic: Chengye feared that Zhi would come to harm and, seizing an opportunity, said to Zhuangzong, "Lu Zhi repeatedly behaves without propriety. Your servant asks to kill him for the Great King — may I?"

sentences.zh: 莊宗曰：「予方招禮賢士，以開霸業，七哥何言之過也！」

translations.literal: Zhuangzong said, "I am just now recruiting worthy men to open the path to hegemony — how can Seventh Elder Brother speak so excessively!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong said, "I am just now recruiting worthy men to build hegemony — how can Seventh Elder Brother speak so harshly!"

sentences.zh: 承業因聳立而言曰：「大王若能如此，何憂不得天下！」

translations.literal: Chengye then stood straight and said, "If the Great King can be like this, what worry is there of not winning the realm!"
translations.idiomatic: Chengye then stood straight and said, "If the Great King can be like this, what worry is there of not winning the realm!"

sentences.zh: 其後盧質雖成縱誕，莊宗終能容之，蓋承業為之藻藉也。

translations.literal: Thereafter, although Lu Zhi grew increasingly unrestrained, Zhuangzong was ultimately able to tolerate him — largely because Chengye had provided the face-saving cover.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, although Lu Zhi grew increasingly unrestrained, Zhuangzong was ultimately able to tolerate him — largely because Chengye had given him cover.

sentences.zh: 十八年，莊宗受諸道勸進，將纂帝位。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the various circuits urged Zhuangzong to ascend, and he was about to seize the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the various circuits urged Zhuangzong to take the throne, and he was about to claim the imperial title.

sentences.zh: 承業以為晉王三代有功於國，先人怒朱氏弑逆，將復舊邦，讎既未平，不宜輕受推戴。

translations.literal: Chengye held that the Prince of Jin's house had served the state with merit across three generations; his forebears, angered by the Zhu family's usurpation, meant to restore the old realm. With the enemy not yet subdued, one ought not lightly accept elevation.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye held that the Prince of Jin's house had served the state with merit across three generations and that his forebears, angered by the Zhu family's usurpation, meant to restore the old realm. With the enemy not yet subdued, one ought not lightly accept elevation.

sentences.zh: 方疾作，肩輿之鄴宮，見莊宗曰：「王父子血戰三十餘年，蓋言報國仇讎，復唐宗社。

translations.literal: Though he was ill, he was carried in a litter to the palace at Ye, where he saw Zhuangzong and said, "Your Highness and your father have fought in blood for more than thirty years — all to speak of avenging the state's enemy and restoring the Tang imperial altar.
translations.idiomatic: Though he was ill, he was carried in a litter to the palace at Ye, where he saw Zhuangzong and said, "Your Highness and your father have fought in blood for more than thirty years — all to avenge the state's enemy and restore the Tang imperial altar.

sentences.zh: 今元凶未滅，民賦已殫，而遽先大號，蠹耗財力，臣以為不可一也。

translations.literal: The chief culprit is not yet destroyed, and the people's taxes are already exhausted — yet you would hastily assume the great title first, squandering resources. Your servant holds this inadvisable — first point.
translations.idiomatic: The chief culprit is not yet destroyed and the people's taxes are already exhausted, yet you would hastily assume the great title and squander resources. Your servant holds this inadvisable — first point.

sentences.zh: 臣自咸通已來，伏事宮掖，每見國家冊命大禮，儀仗法物，百司庶務，經年草定，臨事猶有不可。

translations.literal: Your servant has served the palace since the Xiantong reign and has seen every grand state investiture — regalia, ritual objects, and the myriad duties of the hundred offices, drafted over years — and even at the event there are still flaws.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has served the palace since the Xiantong era and has seen every grand state investiture — regalia, ritual objects, and the myriad duties of the hundred offices, drafted over years — and even then flaws remain.

sentences.zh: 王若化家為國，新立廟朝，不可乖於制度。

translations.literal: If Your Highness transforms a household into a state and newly establishes ancestral temples and courts, you must not deviate from the established codes.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Highness transforms a household into a state and newly establishes ancestral temples and courts, you must not depart from established codes.

sentences.zh: 制禮作樂，未見其人，臣以為不可二也。

translations.literal: To establish rites and compose music — no suitable person has yet appeared. Your servant holds this inadvisable — second point.
translations.idiomatic: To establish rites and compose music — no suitable person has yet appeared. Your servant holds this inadvisable — second point.

sentences.zh: 舉事量力而行，不可信於遊譚也。」

translations.literal: Undertake affairs according to what your strength allows; do not trust in idle talk."
translations.idiomatic: Undertake affairs according to what your strength allows; do not trust in idle talk."

sentences.zh: 〈（《通鑒考異》引秦再思《洛中記異》云：承業諫帝曰：「大王何不待誅克梁孽，更平吳、蜀，俾天下一家，且先求唐氏子孫立之，後更以天下讓有功者，何人輒敢當之！

translations.literal: (The 《Examination of Discrepancies in the Zizhi Tongjian》 cites Qin Zaisi's 《Records of Strange Events in Luoyang》: Chengye remonstrated with the emperor, saying, "Why does Your Highness not wait until the Liang rebels are destroyed and Wu and Shu are pacified, so that the realm becomes one family? First seek out a descendant of the Tang house and install him, then later yield the realm to the man of merit — who would dare take it!
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Examination of Discrepancies in the Zizhi Tongjian》 cites Qin Zaisi's 《Records of Strange Events in Luoyang》: Chengye remonstrated with the emperor, saying, "Why does Your Highness not wait until the Liang rebels are destroyed and Wu and Shu are pacified, so that the realm becomes one family? First find a descendant of the Tang house and install him, then later yield the realm to the man of merit — who would dare take it!

sentences.zh: 讓一月即一月牢，讓一年即一年牢。

translations.literal: Yield for one month and it holds firm for one month; yield for one year and it holds firm for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Yield for one month and it holds firm for one month; yield for one year and it holds firm for one year.

sentences.zh: 設使高祖再生，太宗復出，又胡為哉！

translations.literal: Even if Gaozu were reborn and Taizong reappeared, what could they do!
translations.idiomatic: Even if Gaozu were reborn and Taizong reappeared, what could they do!

sentences.zh: 今大王一旦自立，頓失從前仗義征伐之旨，人情怠矣。

translations.literal: If Your Highness now proclaims yourself sovereign in a single stroke, you will at once lose the righteous purpose that has guided these campaigns, and men's hearts will slacken.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Highness now proclaims yourself sovereign in a single stroke, you will at once lose the righteous purpose that has guided these campaigns, and men's hearts will slacken.

sentences.zh: 老夫是閹官，不愛大王官職富貴，直以受先王付屬之重，欲為大王立萬年之基爾。」）〉

translations.literal: I am an old eunuch — I care nothing for Your Highness's offices and riches; I speak only because I bore the late king's heavy charge and wish to lay a foundation that will endure ten thousand years.")〉
translations.idiomatic: I am an old eunuch — I care nothing for Your Highness's offices and riches. I speak only because I bore the late king's heavy charge and wish to lay a foundation that will endure ten thousand years.")〉

sentences.zh: 莊宗曰：「奈諸將何？」

translations.literal: Zhuangzong said, "What am I to do about the generals?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong said, "What am I to do about the generals?"

sentences.zh: 承業知莊宗不從，因號泣而言之。

translations.literal: Chengye knew Zhuangzong would not follow his advice and spoke while weeping aloud.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye knew Zhuangzong would not follow his advice and spoke while weeping aloud.

sentences.zh: 十九年十一月二日，以疾卒於晉陽之第，時年七十七。

translations.literal: On the second day of the eleventh month of the nineteenth year he died of illness at his residence in Jinyang, aged seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the eleventh month of the nineteenth year he died of illness at his residence in Jinyang, aged seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 貞簡太后聞喪，遽至其第盡哀，為之行服，如兒侄禮。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Zhenjian, hearing of his death, hurried to his residence to mourn fully, donned mourning garments, and observed the rites as a son or nephew would.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Zhenjian, hearing of his death, hurried to his residence to mourn fully, donned mourning garments, and observed the rites as a son or nephew would.

sentences.zh: 同光初，贈左武衛上將軍，諡曰貞憲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tongguang he was posthumously granted General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Guard and given the posthumous name Zhenxian.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tongguang he was posthumously granted General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Guard and given the posthumous name Zhenxian.

sentences.zh: 〈（《五代史闕文》：莊宗將即位於魏州，承業自太原至，謂莊宗曰：「吾王世奉唐家，最為忠孝，自貞觀以來，王室有難，未嘗不從。

translations.literal: (From the 《Lost Writings on the History of the Five Dynasties》: When Zhuangzong was about to ascend the throne at Weizhou, Chengye came from Taiyuan and said to Zhuangzong, "Our princely house has served the Tang with utmost loyalty and filial piety. Since the Zhenguan reign, whenever the royal house faced crisis, we have never failed to respond.
translations.idiomatic: From the 《Lost Writings on the History of the Five Dynasties》: When Zhuangzong was about to take the throne at Weizhou, Chengye came from Taiyuan and said to Zhuangzong, "Our princely house has served the Tang with utmost loyalty and filial piety. Since the Zhenguan era, whenever the royal house faced crisis, we have never failed to respond.

sentences.zh: 所以老奴三十餘年為吾王捃拾財賦、召補軍馬者，誓滅逆賊朱溫，復本朝宗社耳。

translations.literal: That is why this old slave for more than thirty years has gathered revenue and recruited troops and horses for our prince — swearing to destroy the rebel Zhu Wen and restore our dynasty's imperial altar.
translations.idiomatic: That is why this old slave for more than thirty years has gathered revenue and recruited troops and horses for our prince — swearing to destroy the rebel Zhu Wen and restore our dynasty's imperial altar.

sentences.zh: 今河朔甫定，朱氏尚存，吾王遽即大位，可乎？」

translations.literal: Now the Hebei region has just been pacified and the Zhu clan still survives — can our prince hastily assume the great position?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the Hebei region has just been pacified and the Zhu clan still survives — can our prince hastily assume the throne?"

sentences.zh: 云云。

translations.literal: And so on.
translations.idiomatic: And so on.

sentences.zh: 莊宗曰：「奈諸將意何！」

translations.literal: Zhuangzong said, "What of the generals' wishes!"
translations.idiomatic: Zhuangzong said, "What of the generals' wishes!"

sentences.zh: 承業知不可諫止，乃慟哭曰：「諸侯血戰者，本為李家，今吾王自取之，誤老奴矣！」

translations.literal: Chengye knew he could not dissuade him and wailed, "The feudal lords fought in blood for the Li family — now our prince takes it for himself. You have misled this old slave!"
translations.idiomatic: Chengye knew he could not dissuade him and wailed, "The feudal lords fought in blood for the Li family — now our prince takes it for himself. You have misled this old slave!"

sentences.zh: 即歸太原，不食而死。

translations.literal: He returned to Taiyuan and died by fasting.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Taiyuan and died by fasting.

sentences.zh: 臣謹按：《莊宗實錄》敘承業諫即位事甚詳，惟「吾王自取」之言不書，史官諱之也。）〉

translations.literal: Your servant respectfully notes: The 《Veritable Records of Zhuangzong》 narrates Chengye's remonstrance against enthronement in great detail, but does not record the words "our prince takes it for himself" — the historiographers suppressed it.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Your servant respectfully notes: The 《Veritable Records of Zhuangzong》 narrates Chengye's remonstrance against enthronement in great detail but does not record the words "our prince takes it for himself" — the historiographers suppressed it.)〉

sentences.zh: 張居翰，字德卿。

translations.literal: Zhang Juhan, styled Deqing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Juhan, styled Deqing.

sentences.zh: 咸通初，掖庭令張從玫養之為子，以蔭入仕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xiantong reign, Palace Ward Director Zhang Congmei raised him as a son, and he entered office by inherited privilege.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xiantong era, the palace ward director Zhang Congmei raised him as a son, and he entered office by inherited privilege.

sentences.zh: 中和三年，自容管監軍判官入為學士院判官，遷樞密承旨、內府令，賜緋。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhonghe, from adjutant to the army supervisor of Rongguan he entered service as adjutant to the Hanlin Academy, was promoted to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Inner Palace, and was granted scarlet robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhonghe, from adjutant to the army supervisor of Rongguan he entered service as Hanlin Academy adjutant, was promoted to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Inner Palace, and was granted scarlet robes.

sentences.zh: 昭宗在華下，超授內常侍，出監幽州軍事，秩滿詔歸，節度使劉仁恭表留之。

translations.literal: While Emperor Zhaozong was below Hua, Juhan was promoted out of turn to Palace Attendant, sent out to supervise military affairs at You Prefecture, and when his term expired an edict ordered his return — but military commissioner Liu Rengong memorialized to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: While Emperor Zhaozong was at Hua, Juhan was promoted out of turn to palace attendant and sent to supervise military affairs at Youzhou. When his term expired an edict ordered his return, but military commissioner Liu Rengong memorialized to retain him.

sentences.zh: 天復中，詔誅宦官，仁恭紿奏殺之，匿於大安山之北溪。

translations.literal: During the Tianfu reign, an edict ordered the execution of eunuchs. Rengong falsely reported that he had killed Juhan and hid him in a northern stream valley of Mount Da'an.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianfu era, an edict ordered the execution of eunuchs. Rengong falsely reported that he had killed Juhan and hid him in a northern stream valley of Mount Da'an.

sentences.zh: 天祐三年，汴人攻滄州，仁恭求援於武皇，乃遣居翰與書記馬鬱等率兵助武皇同攻潞州，武皇因留之不遣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianyou, when the Bian army attacked Cang Prefecture, Rengong sought aid from Emperor Wu and sent Juhan with secretary Ma Yu and others to lead troops to help Emperor Wu jointly attack Lu Prefecture. Emperor Wu then retained Juhan and would not send him back.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianyou, when the Bian army attacked Cangzhou, Rengong sought aid from Emperor Wu and sent Juhan with secretary Ma Yu and others to lead troops to help Emperor Wu jointly attack Luzhou. Emperor Wu then retained Juhan and would not send him back.

sentences.zh: 李嗣昭節制昭義，以居翰監其軍，以燕軍三千為部下。

translations.literal: Li Siyao commanded Zhaoyi Circuit and made Juhan supervisor of his army, with three thousand Yan troops as his command.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siyao commanded Zhaoyi Circuit and made Juhan supervisor of his army, with three thousand Yan troops under his command.

sentences.zh: 俄而汴將李思安築夾城以圍潞州，居翰與嗣昭登城保守，以至解圍。

translations.literal: Before long the Bian general Li Si'an built Jiachcheng to besiege Lu Prefecture. Juhan and Siyao mounted the walls to hold firm until the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Bian general Li Si'an built Jiachcheng to besiege Luzhou. Juhan and Siyao mounted the walls to hold firm until the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 自是嗣昭每出征，令居翰知留後事。

translations.literal: From then on, whenever Siyao marched out, he left Juhan in charge of rear affairs.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, whenever Siyao marched out, he left Juhan in charge of rear affairs.

sentences.zh: 同光元年夏四月，召為樞密使，加特進，與郭崇韜對掌機務。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Tongguang he was summoned as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, granted Special Advancement, and shared control of state affairs with Guo Chongtao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Tongguang he was summoned as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, granted Special Advancement, and shared control of state affairs with Guo Chongtao.

sentences.zh: 十月，莊宗將渡河，留居翰與李紹宏同守魏州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, as Zhuangzong was about to cross the river, he left Juhan and Li Shaohong together to hold Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, as Zhuangzong prepared to cross the river, he left Juhan and Li Shaohong to hold Weizhou together.

sentences.zh: 莊宗入汴，加驃騎大將軍，知內侍省事，依前充樞密使。

translations.literal: When Zhuangzong entered Bian, Juhan was promoted to Grand General of Agile Cavalry, made Director of Palace Affairs, and continued as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong entered Bian, Juhan was promoted to Grand General of Agile Cavalry, made Director of Palace Affairs, and continued as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 同光時，宦官幹政，邦家之務皆出於郭崇韜。

translations.literal: During Tongguang, eunuchs meddled in government, but state affairs all issued from Guo Chongtao.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongguang era, eunuchs meddled in government, but state affairs all issued from Guo Chongtao.

sentences.zh: 居翰自以羈旅乘時，擢居重地，每於宣授，不敢有所是非，承顏免過而已，以此脫季年之禍。

translations.literal: Juhan considered himself a wanderer who had seized the moment to rise to a weighty post; at every appointment announcement he dared express no approval or disapproval, merely accepting the ruler's countenance to avoid fault — and by this escaped disaster in his later years.
translations.idiomatic: Juhan saw himself as an outsider who had seized the moment to rise to high office. At every appointment he dared express no opinion, merely deferring to the ruler's mood to avoid blame — and by this escaped disaster in his later years.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，偽蜀王衍既降，詔遷其族於洛陽。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, after the false Shu king Wang Yan had surrendered, an edict ordered his clan relocated to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year, after the Shu ruler Wang Yan had surrendered, an edict ordered his clan relocated to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 行及秦川，時關東已亂，莊宗慮衍為變，遣中官向延嗣馳騎齎詔殺之。

translations.literal: When they reached Qinchuan, the east of the pass was already in turmoil. Zhuangzong feared Yan might stir up trouble and sent the palace eunuch Xiang Yansi galloping with an edict to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Qinchuan, the region east of the pass was already in turmoil. Zhuangzong feared Yan might stir up trouble and sent the palace eunuch Xiang Yansi galloping with an edict to kill him.

sentences.zh: 詔云：「王衍一行，並宜殺戮。」

translations.literal: The edict read: "Wang Yan's entire party should be put to death."
translations.idiomatic: The edict read, "Wang Yan's entire party should be put to death."

sentences.zh: 其詔已經印畫，時居翰在密地，覆視其詔，即就殿柱揩云「行」字，改書「家」字。

translations.literal: The edict had already been sealed and signed. Juhan was then in a private room; he looked the edict over again, went to a hall pillar, erased the character for "party," and changed it to the character for "family."
translations.idiomatic: The edict had already been sealed and signed. Juhan was in a private room; he looked the edict over again, went to a hall pillar, erased the character for "party," and changed it to the character for "family."

sentences.zh: 及衍就戮於秦川驛，止族其近屬而已，其偽官及從行者尚千餘人，皆免其枉濫，居翰之力也。

translations.literal: When Yan was executed at the Qinchuan post station, only his close kin were killed. More than a thousand former Shu officials and attendants who accompanied him were all spared from wrongful slaughter — this was Juhan's doing.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan was executed at the Qinchuan post station, only his close kin were killed. More than a thousand former Shu officials and attendants who accompanied him were all spared from wrongful slaughter — this was Juhan's doing.

sentences.zh: 明宗入洛，居翰謁見於至德宮，待罪雪涕，乞歸田里，詔許之，乃辭歸長安。

translations.literal: When Mingzong entered Luoyang, Juhan had an audience at the Zhide Palace, confessed his faults with tears, and begged to return to his home district. An edict granted this, and he took leave to return to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong entered Luoyang, Juhan had an audience at the Zhide Palace, confessed his faults in tears, and begged to return home. An edict granted this, and he took leave to return to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 仍以其子延貴為西京職事，以供侍養。

translations.literal: His son Yangui was also given a post in the Western Capital to support and serve him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yangui was also given a post in the Western Capital to support and care for him.

sentences.zh: 天成三年四月，以疾卒於長安，時年七十一。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Tiancheng he died of illness at Chang'an, aged seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Tiancheng he died of illness at Chang'an, aged seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 居翰性和而靜，諳悉舊事。

translations.literal: Juhan's nature was gentle and quiet, and he was well versed in old precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Juhan was gentle and quiet by nature and well versed in old precedents.

sentences.zh: 在潞州累年，每春課人育蔬種樹，敦本惠農，有仁者之心焉。

translations.literal: During his many years at Lu Prefecture, every spring he set people to raising vegetables and planting trees, encouraging the fundamentals and benefiting farmers — he had the heart of a benevolent man.
translations.idiomatic: During his many years at Luzhou, every spring he set people to raising vegetables and planting trees, encouraging agriculture and benefiting farmers — he had the heart of a benevolent man.

sentences.zh: 馬紹宏，閹官也。

translations.literal: Ma Shaohong was a eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shaohong was a eunuch.

sentences.zh: 初與孟知祥同為中門使，及周德威薨，莊宗兼領幽州，令紹宏權知州事。

translations.literal: At first he and Meng Zhixiang served together as Commissioners of the Central Gate. When Zhou Dewei died, Zhuangzong also took command of You Prefecture and ordered Shaohong to act as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At first he and Meng Zhixiang served together as Commissioners of the Central Gate. When Zhou Dewei died, Zhuangzong also took command of Youzhou and ordered Shaohong to act as prefect.

sentences.zh: 即位之初，郭崇韜勳望高，舊在紹宏之下，時征潞州監軍張居翰與崇韜並為樞密使，紹宏失望，乃以為宣徽使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of his reign Guo Chongtao's merit and prestige were high, though he had formerly ranked below Shaohong. At the time Zhang Juhan, army supervisor of Lu Prefecture, was summoned and made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs together with Chongtao. Shaohong was disappointed and was instead made Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of his reign Guo Chongtao's merit and prestige were high, though he had formerly ranked below Shaohong. Zhang Juhan, army supervisor of Luzhou, was summoned and made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs together with Chongtao. Shaohong was disappointed and was instead made Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 紹宏以己合當樞密任，常鬱鬱側目於崇韜。

translations.literal: Shaohong believed he ought to have held the Bureau of Military Affairs post and constantly glowered sidelong at Chongtao.
translations.idiomatic: Shaohong believed he ought to have held the Bureau of Military Affairs post and constantly glowered sidelong at Chongtao.

sentences.zh: 崇韜知其慊也，乃置內勾之目，令天下錢穀薄書，悉委裁遣。

translations.literal: Chongtao knew he was discontented and therefore created the post of Inner Auditor, putting all revenue and grain account books throughout the realm under Shaohong's review and disposition.
translations.idiomatic: Chongtao knew he was discontented and therefore created the post of Inner Auditor, putting all revenue and grain account books throughout the realm under Shaohong's review and disposition.

sentences.zh: 既而州郡供報，輒滋煩費，議者以為十羊九牧，深所不可，內勾之目，人以為是妖言。

translations.literal: Before long the reports from prefectures and districts multiplied into vexatious expense; critics said it was like ten sheep with nine shepherds — deeply unacceptable — and people regarded the Inner Auditor post as an absurd invention.
translations.idiomatic: Before long reports from prefectures and districts multiplied into vexatious expense. Critics said it was like ten sheep with nine shepherds — deeply unacceptable — and people regarded the Inner Auditor post as an absurd invention.

sentences.zh: 〈（案：下有闕文。

translations.literal: (Note: There is lacuna below.
translations.idiomatic: (Note: There is lacuna below.

sentences.zh: 據《通鑒》，李嗣源為謠言所屬，危殆者數四，賴宣徽使李紹宏左右營護，以是得全。

translations.literal: According to the 《Zizhi Tongjian》, Li Siyuan was targeted by slander and was several times in mortal danger; he survived only because Palace Secretariat Commissioner Li Shaohong protected him on every side.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Zizhi Tongjian》, Li Siyuan was targeted by slander and was several times in mortal danger; he survived only because Palace Secretariat Commissioner Li Shaohong protected him on every side.

sentences.zh: 天成元年二月己丑朔，以宣徽南院使李紹宏為樞密使。）〉

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, jichou, of the first year of Tiancheng, Li Shaohong, Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.)〉
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, jichou, of the first year of Tiancheng, Li Shaohong, Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.)〉

sentences.zh: 孟漢瓊，本鎮州王鎔之小豎也。

translations.literal: Meng Hanqiong was originally a young attendant of Wang Rong of Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Hanqiong was originally a young attendant of Wang Rong of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 明宗鎮常山，得侍左右。

translations.literal: When Mingzong governed Changshan, Hanqiong came to serve at his side.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong governed Changshan, Hanqiong came to serve at his side.

sentences.zh: 明宗即位，自諸司使累遷宣徽南院使。

translations.literal: When Mingzong ascended the throne, Hanqiong rose in succession from various bureau commissioner posts to Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong ascended the throne, Hanqiong rose in succession from various bureau commissioner posts to Commissioner of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 漢瓊性通黠，善交構。

translations.literal: Hanqiong was clever and shrewd by nature and skilled at intrigue.
translations.idiomatic: Hanqiong was clever and shrewd by nature and skilled at intrigue.

sentences.zh: 初見秦王權重，及挾王淑妃勢，傾心事之；

translations.literal: At first, seeing the Prince of Qin's great power and the backing of Consort Wang Shufei, he devoted himself wholeheartedly to serving him;
translations.idiomatic: At first, seeing the Prince of Qin's great power and the backing of Consort Wang Shufei, he devoted himself wholeheartedly to serving him;

sentences.zh: 及朱、馮用事，又與之締結。

translations.literal: when Zhu and Feng came to power, he allied with them as well.
translations.idiomatic: when Zhu and Feng came to power, he allied with them as well.

sentences.zh: 秦王領兵至天津橋，時漢瓊與朱、馮及康義誠方會議於內庭，謀猶未決，漢瓊獨出死力，先入殿門，奏於明宗，語在《秦王傳》。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Qin led troops to the Tianjin Bridge, Hanqiong was at that moment meeting with Zhu, Feng, and Kang Yicheng in the inner court; the plot was still undecided. Hanqiong alone exerted himself to the utmost, entered the palace gate first, and reported to Mingzong — the account is in the 《Biography of the Prince of Qin》.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Qin led troops to the Tianjin Bridge, Hanqiong was meeting with Zhu, Feng, and Kang Yicheng in the inner court; the plot was still undecided. Hanqiong alone exerted himself to the utmost, entered the palace gate first, and reported to Mingzong — the account is in the 《Biography of the Prince of Qin》.

sentences.zh: 漢瓊即自介馬以召禁軍。

translations.literal: Hanqiong then mounted a horse himself to summon the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: Hanqiong then mounted a horse himself to summon the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 秦王既誅，翌日，令漢瓊馳騎召閔帝於鄴。

translations.literal: After the Prince of Qin was executed, the next day Hanqiong was ordered to ride post-haste to Ye to summon Emperor Min.
translations.idiomatic: After the Prince of Qin was executed, the next day Hanqiong was ordered to ride post-haste to Ye to summon Emperor Min.

sentences.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：遣漢瓊征從厚，且權知天雄軍府事。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to campaign against Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Hanqiong was dispatched to campaign against Conghou and was also made acting administrator of the Tianxiong military governorship.)〉

sentences.zh: 閔帝嗣位，尤恃恩寵，期月之內，累加開府儀同三司、驃騎大將軍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Min succeeded to the throne, Hanqiong relied especially on imperial favor; within a single month he was repeatedly promoted to Grand Preceptor with ceremonials equal to the Three Dukes and Grand General of Agile Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Min succeeded to the throne, Hanqiong relied especially on imperial favor. Within a single month he was repeatedly promoted to Grand Preceptor with ceremonials equal to the Three Dukes and Grand General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 西軍既叛，閔帝急召漢瓊，欲令先入於鄴，漢瓊藏匿不行。

translations.literal: When the western army rebelled, Emperor Min urgently summoned Hanqiong, wishing to send him ahead into Ye first, but Hanqiong hid himself and would not go.
translations.idiomatic: When the western army rebelled, Emperor Min urgently summoned Hanqiong, wishing to send him ahead into Ye first, but Hanqiong hid himself and would not go.

sentences.zh: 潞王行及陝州，乃悉召諸妓妾訣別，欲手刃之，眾知其心，率皆藏竄。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Lu reached Shan Prefecture, he summoned all his courtesans and concubines to bid farewell, intending to kill them with his own hand. Everyone knew his intent and mostly hid themselves away.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Lu reached Shanzhou, he summoned all his courtesans and concubines to bid farewell, intending to kill them with his own hand. Everyone knew his intent and mostly hid themselves away.

sentences.zh: 初，潞王失守於河中，勒歸於清化裏第。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Prince of Lu lost his post at Hezhong, he was compelled to return to his residence in Qinghua Lane.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Prince of Lu lost his post at Hezhong, he was compelled to return to his residence in Qinghua Lane.

sentences.zh: 時王淑妃恒令漢瓊傳教旨於潞王，王善待之，故漢瓊自謂潞王於己有恩。

translations.literal: At that time Consort Wang Shufei constantly had Hanqiong convey imperial instructions to the Prince of Lu, and the prince treated him well; therefore Hanqiong considered that the Prince of Lu owed him a debt of gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Consort Wang Shufei constantly had Hanqiong convey imperial instructions to the Prince of Lu, and the prince treated him well. Hanqiong therefore considered that the Prince of Lu owed him a debt of gratitude.

sentences.zh: 至是，乃單騎至澠池謁見潞王，因自慟哭，欲有所陳。

translations.literal: At this point he rode alone to Mianchi to have an audience with the Prince of Lu, whereupon he wept bitterly himself, wishing to say something.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he rode alone to Mianchi to have an audience with the Prince of Lu, whereupon he wept bitterly, wishing to say something.

sentences.zh: 潞王曰：「 諸事不言可知。」

translations.literal: The Prince of Lu said, "Of all matters, none need be spoken to be understood."
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Lu said, "Of all matters, none need be spoken to be understood."

sentences.zh: 漢瓊即自預從臣之列，尋戮於路左。

translations.literal: Hanqiong then placed himself among the followers in advance, and soon afterward was executed by the roadside.
translations.idiomatic: Hanqiong then placed himself among the followers in advance, and soon afterward was executed by the roadside.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：承業感武皇之大惠，佐莊宗之中興，既義且忠，何以階也。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Chengye, grateful for Emperor Wu's great kindness, assisted Zhuangzong's restoration — righteous and loyal; to what rank could such a man be compared?
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Chengye, grateful for Emperor Wu's great kindness, assisted Zhuangzong's restoration — righteous and loyal. To what rank could such a man be compared?

sentences.zh: 夫如是，則晉之勃貂，秦之景監，去之遠矣。

translations.literal: If so, then Bo Diao of Jin and Jing Jian of Qin stand far removed from him.
translations.idiomatic: If so, then Bo Diao of Jin and Jing Jian of Qin stand far removed from him.

sentences.zh: 居翰改一字於詔書，救千人之濫死，可不謂之仁人矣乎！

translations.literal: Juhan changed one character in an edict and saved a thousand people from wrongful death — can he not be called a man of benevolence!
translations.idiomatic: Juhan changed one character in an edict and saved a thousand people from wrongful death — can he not be called a man of benevolence!

sentences.zh: 如紹宏之爭權，漢瓊之構禍，乃宦者之常態也，又何足以道哉！

translations.literal: As for Shaohong's struggle for power and Hanqiong's sowing of disaster — these are the usual ways of eunuchs; what is there worth mentioning!
translations.idiomatic: As for Shaohong's struggle for power and Hanqiong's sowing of disaster — these are the usual ways of eunuchs. What is there worth mentioning!
